CustomField.description: Subtitle text rendered under the page title on this page's stage card in Stages Mode. The formTemplate LWC reads it into each stage's description (page[Description__c]) when building the stages overview, and FormTemplate_Utility queries it onto the Form_Submission_Stage__c rows. Keep it to one or two short sentences — a rationale or summary that helps a respondent decide whether to open this stage. Has no effect in the linear page-by-page runtime, where pages are shown one at a time and there is no overview card. Long Text Area, 500 characters.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a one- or two-sentence subtitle that appears under the page title on its Stages-view card. A short summary of what the stage covers helps respondents decide whether to start it; this text only shows when the parent Form Template is in Stages Mode.
CustomField.label: Description
